targets.query: AppSpans | where DependencyName == 'AzureOpenAI' | summarize p50=percentile(DependencyLatencyMs,50), p95=percentile(DependencyLatencyMs,95) by bin(Timestamp,1m) | order by Timestamp asc
AppExceptions | where DependencyName == 'AzureOpenAI' | summarize c=count() by bin(Timestamp,1m), ExceptionType | order by Timestamp asc
AppSpans | where DependencyName == 'AzureSpeech' | summarize p95=percentile(DependencyLatencyMs,95) by bin(Timestamp,1m) | order by Timestamp asc
AppExceptions | where DependencyName == 'AzureSpeech' | summarize c=count() by bin(Timestamp,1m), ExceptionType | order by Timestamp asc

AppSpans | where DependencyName in ('AzureOpenAI','AzureSpeech') | where DependencyStatusCode >= 400 or isnotempty(ErrorType) | top 100 by Timestamp desc | project Timestamp, DependencyName, DependencyStatusCode, DependencyLatencyMs, ErrorType, ErrorMessage, CorrelationId, TraceId, Pod
